description: The day in the 260-day Maya calendar for a date: number and nawal (K'iche' and Yucatec name, meaning), and the Long Count. GMT correlation 584283, the count Guatemalan daykeepers keep. The meaning of a day is given by an ajq'ij.
name: get_maya_day
title: The Maya calendar day (Cholq'ij / Tzolk'in)
